WITH player_postseason_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.player_id,
    p.bats,
    AVG(bp.double) as avg_doubles
  FROM batting_postseason bp
  JOIN player p ON bp.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats != ''
  GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats
  HAVING AVG(bp.double) IS NOT NULL
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) as overall_avg
  FROM player_postseason_avg
),
indexed AS (
  SELECT 
    ppa.player_id,
    ppa.bats,
    ppa.avg_doubles,
    ppa.avg_doubles / oa.overall_avg as index_value
  FROM player_postseason_avg ppa
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
),
hand_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    bats,
    AVG(index_value) as hand_avg_index
  FROM indexed
  GROUP BY bats
),
final_result AS (
  SELECT 
    i.player_id,
    i.bats,
    i.avg_doubles,
    i.index_value,
    i.index_value - ha.hand_avg_index as index_diff
  FROM indexed i
  JOIN hand_avg ha ON i.bats = ha.bats
)
SELECT 
  player_id,
  bats,
  avg_doubles,
  index_value,
  index_diff
FROM final_result
ORDER BY 
  index_diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
